supportAnchorPolicy.reason: Separately inspected all 16 seated frames on this exact new source: visible feet share the core bottom. The lowest 12-pixel support silhouette also includes shorts and minor dumbbell overlap; it is not an anatomical foot-only mask. This narrower reviewed support band reduces registered top-head horizontal range from 21 to 3 source pixels, without per-frame scaling or smoothing. Do not apply to another source hash.

limitations: 本報告獨立於既有172格報告，只提供本輪三個候選；美術仍未批准。
可見臉横截、眼下緣間距與眼足距是姿勢／表情代理，並非完整頭部或裸軀幹模型。
廚師真足底與坐墊落位分開；尺線必須使用eyeToFootPoints/footSourcePoint，不能接到region anchor。
遮擋、閉眼或不可靠欄位保持null；新運動素材只有定位證據，不借用舊圖人體landmarks。
每個clip固定一個scale；來源RGB/alpha、輪廓、播放格序与舊報告未修改。
